card.name: Thousands comma inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: The comma separating thousands in a number right after a leading digit, such as 1,000 or 1:200,000, in dose or concentration text. It fires just before the three zeros.

modes.label: Epinephrine ratio
modes.description: Comma in the 1:200,000 epinephrine dilution after a local anesthetic.

modes.label: Dose in mg
modes.description: Comma in a 1,000 mg or 2,000 mg dose or range.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens meaning thousands, so it seems to steer away from word-style thousand terms after the comma.
card.plain: It marks the comma in a number like 1,000 or 200,000 inside a dose or dilution.
